name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Adopt a 3-pixel solid focus ring in the brand color with a 3-pixel outer glow at 30% opacity for keyboard navigation. This ensures visibility against any background while keeping the glow subtle enough not to overwhelm content. The trade-off is slightly reduced contrast for the glow itself, but the solid ring guarantees the focus target remains clear in all lighting conditions.

name: Reader
text: Risk: The 3px ring + 3px glow creates a "halo effect" that can obscure adjacent elements, especially at 125% zoom where the 30% opacity glow bleeds into nearby content. Better alternative: Use a 2px solid focus ring with a 2px outer glow at 20% opacity—reduces bleed while maintaining visibility. Settle it with a live contrast test against the darkest/lightest backgrounds in the design system.

name: Ramp
text:
Adopt the 2-pixel solid focus ring with a 2-pixel outer glow at 20% opacity. This keeps the focus indicator crisp and avoids the halo effect that obscures adjacent elements, especially at 125% zoom. The trade-off is slightly less visual prominence, but the reduced glow bleed ensures content remains fully visible and usable.

name: Reader
text: Risk: The 2px ring + 2px glow at 20% opacity still bleeds at 125% zoom—just less. Better alternative: Drop the glow entirely. Use a 3px solid ring in the brand color with a 1px inner shadow (same color, 50% opacity) for depth. Settle it with a live contrast test against a busy background at 125% zoom.

name: Access
text: DECISION: Ship a 3px solid focus ring in the brand color with a 1px inner shadow at 50% opacity, delivering a clear and visible focus indicator that passes live contrast tests against busy backgrounds at 125% zoom, and the lead developer owns the implementation of this artifact.
